name: Three-Tone Sunburst
inspiration: A three-tone sunburst dreadnought and the vinyl-sleeve editorials of the era: amber center, tobacco mid, near-black rim. A classic long-scroll magazine where every chapter opens through a burst.

display.stack: 'Fraunces Variable', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, 'Book Antiqua', 'URW Palladio L', Georgia, serif
display.note: Warm old-style serif, italic for kickers, large optical sizes

body.stack: 'Newsreader Variable', Charter, 'Bitstream Charter', Cambria, Georgia, serif

motion.note: One long scroll driven by ScrollTrigger. Each section is a chapter: a radial sunburst gradient blooms open as the chapter pins, the headline settles letter-spaced into place, items reveal with a stagger. Scrubbed parallax on the burst art; nothing autoplays.
